transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

I suppose... I just feel like the part of me that used to reach out to people has gone very quiet lately. I don't really take pleasure in things anymore. My work... yoga, going to galleries. Even just journaling. It's... I don't know. I'm mostly just moving through my obligations right now. So... I guess that's what brought me in.
Did something significant happen in your life before you started feeling this way?

I'm not sure if you'd call it significant, but... it's been about eight months. We took an older relative into our apartment around then. I suppose that's when this whole change in how I'm thinking... and working, and connecting with people really started.
Do you feel this started because of your relative moving in?
I... I don't really know. I wouldn't necessarily say it's because of them. It's just... that's just around the time I noticed things changing.
Do you feel that having your relative move in is what’s causing these changes for you?
Like I said... I really couldn't tell you. It's just the timing of when I started noticing things. I wouldn't necessarily call it the cause.
Have you had a period of at least two weeks when you felt this down or uninterested in things nearly every day?
I... no, I don't think so. I haven't really noticed feeling down for two straight weeks like that. It's... it's not really like that.
For at least two years, have you felt this way on most days?
Two years? No... I haven't felt like this for that long. It's... no.
Have these changes been interfering with your ability to function in daily life?

I mean... I guess it has a little. I'm still going to work. But... I've missed a few grant deadlines. And my supervisor... she quietly moved some of my more demanding clients to other clinicians. I suppose I'm just... not functioning at my usual level right now.
Before this period began, have you ever had another time in your life when you lost interest in things and felt this emotionally shut down in a similar way?
No... I don't think so. I can't really remember another time where I felt... quite like this. It's just been recently.
Would you say this has been causing you a lot of emotional distress?
I don't know... not really. I wouldn't call it distress. It's just... kind of how things are right now. I'm not really upset about it.
Do you feel your current changes are related to the stress of your older relative moving into your home?
No... I'm not sure what you mean. I don't have any older relatives moving in with me. So... no.
Just to clarify, is anyone currently living with you in your home who was not living there before this started?

Well... I mean, nobody is moving in right now. But... I guess we did take my older relative into our apartment. That was about eight months ago. So... that's about how long all of this has been going on. The changes in how I'm thinking, and working... and connecting with people.
Have you been feeling anxious a lot lately?
I don't... no. Not really. I wouldn't say I've been anxious.
Do you feel overwhelmed by having your older relative living with you?
No... not overwhelmed. It's just... they live there now. It's fine.
Would you say these changes have been causing problems in your daily functioning?

I suppose... maybe a little. I mean, I’m still showing up to work. But... I guess I've missed some grant deadlines lately. And my supervisor... well, she's quietly moved a few of my more demanding clients to other clinicians. Just... because I’m not really functioning at my usual level right now. But I am still going in.
Do you feel these changes began because your older relative moved into your home?

I don't know if it's because of that... but... I suppose the timing lines up. It's been about eight months. Just... this whole shift in how I'm working and... thinking about things, or connecting with people. It started right around when we took them into our apartment. So... maybe.
Do you feel that taking your older relative into your home has been stressful for you?
I don't know. I wouldn't really call it stressful, exactly. It's just... an adjustment. We just share the space now, so... it is what it is. I haven't really thought about it that way.
Have you noticed any change in your sleep lately?
Not really. I guess I sleep about the same as I always have. I haven't really been paying attention to it.
Have you been feeling unusually tired or low on energy lately?
I don't think so. Just... normal energy, I guess. I haven't really noticed being more tired than usual.
Have you been feeling sad or down lately?
No, not really. I mean... things are fine. I'm just going about my day, mostly. So... no, I wouldn't say I've been down.
Do you think these changes are mainly a reaction to your older relative moving into your home?

I don't know if it's a reaction, exactly. But... I guess it has been about eight months since we took my older relative into our apartment. That's roughly how long this whole change has been going on. Just... with how I'm thinking, and my work. Connecting with people. It just started around then.

Major depressive episode is not supported because the patient denied sustained depressed mood, denied a distinct 2-week period of near-daily depressive symptoms, and lacks several core vegetative symptoms.
